title: Hash functions: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-2 and why the first two fell

videos.script: A hash function takes anything, a word or a whole disk, and returns a short fingerprint of fixed length. {{title}} Change one letter, and the fingerprint changes completely. {{avalanche}} That makes it the tool for checking that a file is the one you expected. {{checksum}} It also sits inside every signature and every certificate. A signature does not sign the document. It signs the document's fingerprint. {{signature}} So a hash that lets two documents share one fingerprint breaks every signature built on it. That happened to MD5, and then to SHA-1. {{timeline}} This lesson is what a hash promises, which ones keep the promise today, and how the two famous ones lost it.
